evidence: Below the legend line '25GbE RoCE: assumed effective 2.5 GB/s' and above the caption 'FIGURE 9.1: Eight-rank ring all-reduce time...' the page shows the body-text fragment 'cal model; no offload, no per-step latency, no comm/comp overlap; send/recv full-duplex; not me'.
